name: Discovair G2 acoustic array (Squarehead)
description: Passive 128-microphone array with ML classification. Tracks Group 1-2 UAS by sound, including RF-silent drones.

sectorDeg.condition: 105 deg in directional mode; 360 deg in hemispheric mode
sectorDeg.source: Squarehead Technology drone detection page (Discovair G2+)

rangeAccuracyM.note: A single acoustic node measures bearing at best, not range; not established by the public record.

azimuthAccuracyDeg.condition: direction accuracy <10° azimuth (vendor bound taken as 1 sigma)
azimuthAccuracyDeg.source: Squarehead Discovair G2 product sheet v1.3 (cuashub mirror): direction accuracy '<10°' azimuth/elevation, quoted from the search index; the PDF was blocked on read

elevationAccuracyDeg.condition: direction accuracy <10° elevation (vendor bound taken as 1 sigma)
elevationAccuracyDeg.source: Squarehead Discovair G2 product sheet v1.3 (cuashub mirror): direction accuracy '<10°' azimuth/elevation, quoted from the search index; the PDF was blocked on read

noiseFloorDb.note: Planning factor: the detection threshold implied by this record's own refAcousticDb (75 dB at 1 m) and detectRangeM (500 m) under spherical spreading, 75 - 20 log10(500) = 21 dB re 20 µPa, so the range the record already carries is reproduced. A 128-microphone beamformer gains about 10 log10(128) = 21 dB over a single microphone, which is why the effective threshold sits below the 30 to 35 dBA rural ambient. Squarehead publishes no threshold (sqhead.com/defense; product sheet v1.3 unreachable today).
